resetPassword.resultReminder: This password is shown only once — copy it and send it to the student now. If you lose it, just reset again. Remind them to change it under "Change password" after logging in.
resetPassword.step1: The student contacts you saying they forgot their password and gives you their username.
resetPassword.step2: Enter their username (or pick one from the suggestions) and press Reset password.
resetPassword.step3: Copy the new password shown on screen, send it to the student, and remind them to change it right away.
resetPassword.noteBody: The new password is a random 6-character string shown exactly once after the reset — nothing stores it for later viewing. Only reset once you're sure who you're talking to.
